children.text: Ruth’s Marriage Private Premarital Counseling Classes is for seriously dating/courting, engaged, and newlywed couples. The classes are private – between Coach Ruth and the Couple only.

The classes hold for six weeks – once a week and covers all foundational topics for marriage. These classes are very comprehensive and intricately designed to prepare both partners extensively for marriage, help them build a strong foundation; whilst also providing early intervention counseling on personal challenges they may be experiencing
The private classes are a great opportunity for you to ask questions, confront issues and disagreements that could potentially harm the marriage.
In this therapy cycle, my focus will be to help you become a better version of yourself, identify the changes & steps to take to have a healthier you and a healthier relationship or marriage

You will have a safe space to explore your thoughts, feelings, and concerns without fear or judgement; while I hold your hands spiritually, mentally, and emotionally to ensure you achieve the goals we set during these sessions and leave no stone unturned. I will provide you with tools, practical wisdom, and research-based strategies that will propel you to the next level in your relationship and your personal life.
Let’s begin the transformation you desire!

Marriages sometimes require a long process of counseling and therapy to effect a change. These therapy sessions will help you identify the pitfalls in your marriage and provide you with tools, counsel, and research-based solutions that will help you achieve the kind of marriage you desire
In these sessions, it is important that you are both willing to put in the work with me. We will set the goals of your therapy and I will work with you to achieve the goals we set.
Before you give up on that marriage, let’s have therapy! Let me help you!

This is a two-time zoom video session with a married or engaged couple. In these sessions, it is compulsory for both partners to turn their videos on and be present. After the first session, the second session holds the following week. Each session lasts for one hour.
This is a one hour virtual counseling session for a married or engaged couple. In this zoom session, it is compulsory for both partners to turn their videos on and be present
This is a one hour virtual counseling session for a married individual.
This is a four weeks (four sessions) coaching cycle for a dating couple. A session holds once weekly.

A relationship does not only progress because you like each other, it progresses based on how much knowledge you both have to build the relationship. Even couples with the deepest affection for one another may run into issues.

These coaching sessions will help you to individually become self-aware, learn effective communication and conflict resolution techniques, set appropriate boundaries in your relationships, and guide you to purposeful dating.

title: One Hour Dating Couples Counseling Session

children.text: This is a one-hour counseling/coaching session for a dating couple. In this session, you will be able to identify your unhealthy patterns, improve your communication & conflict resolution skills and gain insight into making an informed decision about your relationship
In this session, it is compulsory for both partners to turn their videos on and be present.
The choice of a life partner is one of the most important decisions you will ever make. Many people do not have clarity regarding this and are confused about how to make that decision.

In this clarity call, I will provide you counsel on how to navigate the process of choosing a life partner and also analyze your current relationship (if you are in one) whilst providing guidance on your decision.
I will help you analyze your standards to be sure they are not unrealistic, unnecessary, and sub-standard.
